newsitem.title: UK: Property analyst winner in Reuters survey revised.
newsitem.headline: Property analyst winner in Reuters survey revised.

text.p: Tempest Consultants Ltd on Friday corrected the results of finance director voting for property sector analysts in the 1997 Reuters survey of UK larger company research released this week.

Tempest said elimination of an error, which arose from confusion over two analysts named R. Moore, meant that Roger Moore and colleagues at SBC Warburg were voted as top analysts in the sector by finance directors, with 20.89 percent of the votes.
The correction pushed Dresdner Kleinwort Benson into second place, with Cazenove & Co third.
